requests.name: Get or Create Conversation
requests.description: Get or create a conversation with another user. **Parameters:** - `userId`: ID of the user to chat with **Returns:** - Conversation object with other user info - Creates conversation if it doesn't exist **Note:** You cannot create a conversation with yourself. **Response Structure:** ```json { "success": true, "message": "تم جلب المحادثة بنجاح", "data": { "id": 1, "other_user": { ... }, "last_message_at": null, "unread_count": 0, "created_at": "2026-02-13T09:00:00.000000Z" } } ```

requests.name: Get All Conversations
requests.description: Get all conversations for the authenticated user. **Returns:** - List of conversations with other user info - Unread count for each conversation - Last message timestamp **Response Structure:** ```json { "success": true, "message": "تم جلب المحادثات بنجاح", "data": [ { "id": 1, "other_user": { "id": 2, "name": "John Doe", "email": "john@example.com" }, "last_message_at": "2026-02-13T10:30:00.000000Z", "unread_count": 3, "created_at": "2026-02-13T09:00:00.000000Z" } ] } ```

requests.name: Mark Messages as Read
requests.description: Mark all messages in a conversation as read. **Parameters:** - `conversationId`: ID of the conversation **Returns:** - Success message - All unread messages from other user are marked as read **Note:** Messages are automatically marked as read when you fetch them via GET /messages endpoint. **Response Structure:** ```json { "success": true, "message": "تم تحديد الرسائل كمقروءة" } ```

requests.name: Delete Message
requests.description: Delete a message. **Parameters:** - `messageId`: ID of the message to delete **Returns:** - Success message **Note:** You can only delete your own messages. **Response Structure:** ```json { "success": true, "message": "تم حذف الرسالة بنجاح" } ```

requests.name: Get Unread Count
requests.description: Get total unread messages count across all conversations. **Returns:** - Total count of unread messages from all conversations **Use Case:** - Display badge with unread count in UI - Show notification indicator **Response Structure:** ```json { "success": true, "message": "تم جلب عدد الرسائل غير المقروءة بنجاح", "data": { "unread_count": 5 } } ```
